lines.zh: 每踏一步，地皮都在替我数生物质。
lines.en: Each step I take, the ground counts my biomass.

lines.zh: 我从百份生物质里长出了这副骨架。
lines.en: A hundred biomass built this frame I walk in.

lines.zh: 二十格外的猎物，也逃不出我的视线。
lines.en: Prey twenty blocks off still sits inside my sight.

lines.zh: 沿途的墙，早晚会变成我的射击台。
lines.en: These walls will serve as my firing platform soon.

lines.zh: 灾厄重构体孵出的东西，走路带风。
lines.en: Hatched from a reconstruct, I walk with a storm.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖在地上，像一节上膛的炮。
lines.en: My tail drags low, a loaded cannon behind me.

lines.zh: 三百点生命压在脚掌，地面只好让步。
lines.en: Three hundred health bears down; the ground gives way.

lines.zh: 别数我的步子，数你剩下的距离。
lines.en: Do not count my steps; count the ground you lose.

lines.zh: 这双甲壳靴子踩碎过不少村庄的门。
lines.en: These armored boots have crushed a few village doors.

lines.zh: 高处五格，我也能抬头把弹送到。
lines.en: Five blocks up, my shells still find your face.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但每步都在缩短围城。
lines.en: I am slow, but every step tightens the siege.

lines.zh: 后颈的肿瘤一鼓一鼓，替我倒计时。
lines.en: The tumor at my nape pulses, counting down for you.

lines.zh: 生物质在体内缓慢翻涌，像涨潮。
lines.en: Biomass churns slowly inside me, like a rising tide.

lines.zh: 孵我的概率不到三成，我记住了。
lines.en: Under three in ten odds hatched me; I remember.

lines.zh: 护甲二十五层，闲着也是闲着。
lines.en: Twenty-five layers of armor, and nothing to do.

lines.zh: 尾巴空转了一下，弹膛还是热的。
lines.en: My tail spins idle; the chamber is still warm.

lines.zh: 没有猎物的时候，我就磨肿瘤的边。
lines.en: With no prey, I grind the edges of my tumors.

lines.zh: 风穿过甲缝，声音像远处的攻城锤。
lines.en: Wind through my plates sounds like a distant ram.

lines.zh: 站着不动，也在等二十格外的动静。
lines.en: Standing still, I still listen twenty blocks out.

lines.zh: 灾厄不需要睡，只需要下一场围城。
lines.en: A catastrophe does not sleep, only waits to siege.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸放慢，让地面先害怕。
lines.en: I slow my breathing so the ground fears first.

lines.zh: 身上的菌斑在暗处一下一下发亮。
lines.en: The fungal patches on me glow, dim then bright.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在我射程正中。
lines.en: You are standing dead center in my range.

lines.zh: 抬头看我，能看见尾尖对着你。
lines.en: Look up and you will see my tail aimed.

lines.zh: 你的护甲，在我眼里只是一层纸。
lines.en: Your armor reads as paper to my eyes.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的铁，村庄的味道。
lines.en: I know that iron in your hand; it smells of villages.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，肿瘤弹飞得比视线快。
lines.en: Do not blink; tumor shells outrun your gaze.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就多一颗弹上膛。
lines.en: One step back from you, one more shell loaded.

lines.zh: 我在估你的高度，差五格就开火。
lines.en: I am measuring your height; five blocks and I fire.

lines.zh: 眼睛下面的裂口，是在笑你。
lines.en: The split beneath my eye is laughing at you.

lines.zh: 你这样盯着我，像在数自己的血。
lines.en: Staring at me like that, you count your own blood.

lines.zh: 看够了没有，我的耐心只有一轮齐射。
lines.en: Seen enough? My patience lasts one volley.

lines.zh: 二十五层甲，你才磨掉一层。
lines.en: Twenty-five plates, and you have scratched one.

lines.zh: 疼，但生物质会替我补上。
lines.en: It stings, but biomass will patch it soon.

lines.zh: 三百点生命，够你砍很久。
lines.en: Three hundred health will take you a long while.

lines.zh: 你的刀太浅，像在敲门。
lines.en: Your blade is too shallow; it sounds like knocking.

lines.zh: 我退半步，只是换个射击角度。
lines.en: I step back only to change my firing angle.

lines.zh: 伤口冒出的菌丝，比血更吵。
lines.en: The mycelium from my wound is louder than blood.

lines.zh: 这一下记下了，等会儿加倍还。
lines.en: Noted; I will return it double in a moment.

lines.zh: 别高兴，甲裂不等于我软。
lines.en: Do not celebrate; a cracked plate is not weakness.

lines.zh: 你打中的是肿瘤，不是要害。
lines.en: You struck a tumor, not anything vital.

lines.zh: 痛感让我把射程又看了一遍。
lines.en: Pain makes me recheck my range one more time.

lines.zh: 收起你的面包，我只咽生物质。
lines.en: Put your bread away; I swallow only biomass.

lines.zh: 你以为喂饱我，围城就会停？
lines.en: Feed me and you think the siege will stop?

lines.zh: 灾厄的胃不认麦子，只认数字。
lines.en: A catastrophe's gut knows numbers, not wheat.

lines.zh: 那点熟肉，还不够我一颗肿瘤弹。
lines.en: That cooked meat weighs less than one tumor shell.

lines.zh: 你举着胡萝卜的样子，很像我踩过的农夫。
lines.en: Holding out carrots, you look like farmers I crushed.

lines.zh: 我不吃讨好，只吃距离。
lines.en: I do not eat flattery; I eat distance.

lines.zh: 把食物扔掉，把武器捡起来。
lines.en: Drop the food and pick your weapon back up.

lines.zh: 饥饿这个词，早被生物质改写了。
lines.en: The word hunger was rewritten by biomass long ago.

lines.zh: 你手里的糖，换不来我少走一步。
lines.en: Sugar in your hand buys not one step less.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是铁锈，不是你的晚餐。
lines.en: What I smell is rust, not your dinner.

lines.zh: 撞上来吧，二十五层甲不躲人。
lines.en: Come crash into me; twenty-five plates never dodge.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像敲了一下城墙。
lines.en: You hit my leg like a knock on a city wall.

lines.zh: 别挤，肿瘤弹需要一点空间起飞。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; tumor shells need room to launch.

lines.zh: 三百点生命，撞你一下绰绰有余。
lines.en: Three hundred health is plenty to bump you flat.

lines.zh: 我一步没挪，你已经退了半步。
lines.en: I have not moved; you already gave half a step.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，是想听甲壳里的菌声？
lines.en: This close, do you hear the fungus in my shell?

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过你脚边，那算警告。
lines.en: My tail brushed your feet; consider that a warning.

lines.zh: 撞我的代价，是把自己送进射程。
lines.en: Bumping me just delivers you into my range.

lines.zh: 灾厄的肩膀不给人靠，只给人碎。
lines.en: A catastrophe's shoulder is for breaking, not leaning.

lines.zh: 退开两格，我还能当没发生。
lines.en: Back off two blocks and I will forget this.

lines.zh: 重构体没有伴侣，只有下一批。
lines.en: Reconstructs take no mate, only the next batch.

lines.zh: 我的后代从孵化槽里出来，不从我身边。
lines.en: My brood comes from a vat, not from my side.

lines.zh: 灾厄的血脉靠生物质接续，不靠温柔。
lines.en: Catastrophe bloodlines continue through biomass, not tenderness.

lines.zh: 你想配对？先凑够一百份生物质。
lines.en: Want to pair with me? Gather a hundred biomass first.

lines.zh: 我不会为谁停下围城的脚步。
lines.en: I will not halt a siege for anyone's sake.

lines.zh: 这类事交给孵化体，我只管开路。
lines.en: Leave breeding to the hatchery; I clear the road.

lines.zh: 我的甲片不给人摸，包括同类。
lines.en: No one touches my plates, not even my own kind.

lines.zh: 想要我的基因，得先活过一轮齐射。
lines.en: Want my genes? Survive one volley first.

lines.zh: 同类相遇只点头，然后各打各的城。
lines.en: Kin nod once, then each takes a different city.

lines.zh: 感情对肿瘤弹没用，别浪费弹药。
lines.en: Affection does nothing for tumor shells; save the ammo.

lines.zh: 这堆生物质，够我换一颗新肿瘤。
lines.en: This pile of biomass buys me one fresh tumor.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只用尾巴，手留着挥。
lines.en: I pick things up with my tail; hands are for swinging.

lines.zh: 别捡了，那点铁连我的甲缝都塞不满。
lines.en: Stop looting; that iron will not fill one plate gap.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，归走过的那一方。
lines.en: What falls to the ground belongs to the one who walks.

lines.zh: 我收下这块腐肉，当作路上的补给。
lines.en: I take this rotten flesh as road supply.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我替你拿一段路。
lines.en: What you dropped, I will carry a while.

lines.zh: 拾取是围城的余兴，不是正事。
lines.en: Looting is a siege's afterthought, not the work.

lines.zh: 这块骨头不错，能当牙签。
lines.en: This bone is good; it will serve as a toothpick.

lines.zh: 生物质要攒，攒够百份我就能再长。
lines.en: Biomass must be hoarded; a hundred more and I grow.

lines.zh: 别抢，我尾尖还夹着三颗弹。
lines.en: Do not grab; my tail still holds three shells.

lines.zh: 二十格，正好是开火的距离。
lines.en: Twenty blocks: exactly the distance to open fire.

lines.zh: 你抬头的那一刻，我锁定了。
lines.en: The moment you looked up, I had you locked.

lines.zh: 目标确认，生物质计数加一。
lines.en: Target confirmed; biomass count goes up by one.

lines.zh: 你比我低五格，那更容易。
lines.en: You are five blocks below me; that is easier.

lines.zh: 我听见你的靴子，在二十三格外。
lines.en: I hear your boots at twenty-three blocks out.

lines.zh: 别跑，我的弹会拐个小弯。
lines.en: Do not run; my shells bend a little on the way.

lines.zh: 选你了，其他人可以再等一轮。
lines.en: You are chosen; the rest can wait a volley.

lines.zh: 三百点生命对上你，不太公平。
lines.en: Three hundred health against you is hardly fair.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴抬起来了，这是点名。
lines.en: My tail is rising; that is your name called.

lines.zh: 二十格内，你连影子都藏不住。
lines.en: Within twenty blocks, you cannot hide your shadow.

lines.zh: 锁定完成，三到六颗，请随意躲。
lines.en: Lock complete: three to six shells, dodge as you like.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太响，我顺着它找过来。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is loud; I followed it here.

lines.zh: 灾厄记性不好，但记得猎物味道。
lines.en: Catastrophes forget much, but remember prey scent.

lines.zh: 目标就是你，别东张西望。
lines.en: The target is you; stop looking around.

lines.zh: 生物质在跳，说明附近有肉。
lines.en: The biomass twitches; meat is near.

lines.zh: 抬高一点，别让肿瘤弹白跑。
lines.en: A touch higher, so my shells do not waste the trip.

lines.zh: 你躲在墙后，墙挡不住范围。
lines.en: Hide behind the wall; the wall stops no blast radius.

lines.zh: 我在算提前量，你的腿比嘴慢。
lines.en: I am leading my shot; your legs are slower than your mouth.

lines.zh: 再跑两格，正好进齐射的甜点。
lines.en: Two more blocks and you enter my volley's sweet spot.

lines.zh: 尾尖发热，说明它喜欢你站的位置。
lines.en: My tail tip heats up; it likes where you stand.

lines.zh: 我数三下，你就该换方向了。
lines.en: I count to three, then you should change direction.

lines.zh: 你踩的每块石头，我都记了坐标。
lines.en: Every stone you step on, I have its coordinates.

lines.zh: 抬头，我要把弹送到你头顶。
lines.en: Look up; I am sending shells over your head.

lines.zh: 别以为低处就安全，弹会落。
lines.en: Low ground is not safe; my shells come down.

lines.zh: 我在缩短距离，你在我射程里变慢。
lines.en: I close the gap; inside my range, you slow down.

lines.zh: 三颗先试水，剩下三颗看你反应。
lines.en: Three shells to test you, three more for your reaction.

lines.zh: 你的盾举错了方向，我在这边。
lines.en: Your shield faces the wrong way; I am over here.

lines.zh: 二十格到十五格，只差你一口气。
lines.en: Twenty blocks to fifteen: one breath of yours apart.

lines.zh: 别停，停下来我就换瞄准点。
lines.en: Do not stop; if you stop, I shift my aim.

lines.zh: 我把弹道压平，先打你的脚。
lines.en: I flatten the arc and hit your feet first.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后，树干会先碎。
lines.en: Hide behind the trunk; the trunk breaks first.

lines.zh: 我抬尾，你就该找掩体了。
lines.en: My tail lifts; time to find cover.

lines.zh: 你往上爬，我在上面等你。
lines.en: Climb up; I will be waiting at the top.

lines.zh: 三十点伤害，落在你肩上。
lines.en: Thirty points of damage lands on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一拳没带弹，纯粹是礼貌。
lines.en: This punch carries no shell; it is pure courtesy.

lines.zh: 你不该让我走到的距离。
lines.en: You should never have let me reach this range.

lines.zh: 骨头响的那声，我听着很舒服。
lines.en: That crack of bone is a sound I enjoy.

lines.zh: 甲壳擦过你的脸，留个记号。
lines.en: My plate grazes your face; a mark to keep.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫你一下，算提前收尾。
lines.en: One tail sweep, and I end this early.

lines.zh: 别挡，我的手比弹更近。
lines.en: Do not block; my hand is closer than the shells.

lines.zh: 你退一格，我尾巴就前压一格。
lines.en: One block back, and my tail presses one block forward.

lines.zh: 二十五层甲推着你往墙角走。
lines.en: Twenty-five plates push you toward the corner.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我还没用尾巴。
lines.en: Does it hurt? I have not used my tail yet.

lines.zh: 这一下是围城的老规矩。
lines.en: This blow is old siege custom.

lines.zh: 你的剑碰到甲，弹回来了吧。
lines.en: Your sword hits my plate and bounces back, right?

lines.zh: 我出手慢，但一次就够。
lines.en: I swing slowly, but once is enough.

lines.zh: 倒下之前，记住是谁的拳头。
lines.en: Before you fall, remember whose fist this was.

lines.zh: 我一肘砸下，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: One elbow down and the ground caves in.

lines.zh: 你的甲裂了，我的手没停。
lines.en: Your armor cracks; my hand keeps going.

lines.zh: 一百份生物质喂出的东西，醒了。
lines.en: Something fed a hundred biomass has woken up.

lines.zh: 孵化槽裂开，我踩着碎片站起来。
lines.en: The vat cracks; I rise through the shards.

lines.zh: 两成半的概率，落到了这片土地。
lines.en: A one-in-four chance landed on this soil.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，先量了二十格的距离。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and measured twenty blocks first.

lines.zh: 灾厄重构体，在此重新开工。
lines.en: The catastrophe reconstruct resumes work here.

lines.zh: 湿漉漉的肿瘤，还在我背上发烫。
lines.en: Wet tumors still burn hot along my back.

lines.zh: 谁把我孵出来的？不重要，先围城。
lines.en: Who hatched me? Irrelevant. The siege comes first.

lines.zh: 我落地的那声，惊动了整片林子。
lines.en: My landing woke the whole forest around here.

lines.zh: 新生的甲还没硬，脾气已经硬了。
lines.en: New armor is still soft; my temper is not.

lines.zh: 空气里有铁味，说明有人等着。
lines.en: There is iron in the air; someone is waiting.

lines.zh: 我带来的第一件礼物，是影子。
lines.en: The first gift I bring is my shadow.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片的距离归我量。
lines.en: From today, I measure every distance here.

lines.zh: 火烧到肿瘤，整条尾巴都在炸。
lines.en: Flame reaches my tumors and my whole tail bursts.

lines.zh: 落地的震动，把我的弹抖散了。
lines.en: The landing shock scatters the shells in my tail.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲缝，菌丝全在冒泡。
lines.en: Water floods my plate gaps; the mycelium bubbles.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了我，甲片飞了一地。
lines.en: The blast flips me; my plates scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭插在甲缝里，像根多余的刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my plate seam, a useless thorn.

lines.zh: 那股怪力钻进骨头，我抖了一下。
lines.en: That strange force crawls into my bones; I shudder.

lines.zh: 生物质见底，肿瘤开始互相啃。
lines.en: Biomass runs low; my tumors begin gnawing each other.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的甲成了避雷针。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my armor becomes a rod.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，只有一片空的回声。
lines.en: Below is no ground, only an echoing emptiness.
